summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on 26 May 2026, reporting a block admission application to the London Stock Exchange for 500,000,000 ordinary shares of 10p each. These shares are to be allotted and issued under employee share plans (Share Incentive Plan, Sharesave Scheme, Deferred Bonus Plan, Long Term Share Plan, Long Term Incentive Plan) and will rank equally with existing shares. Admission is expected on 27 May 2026. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation. No deal terms or strategic event are present.
